messages:
maria: Heads-up: onboarding Bermuda's LoRA on redwood/galena-13b (4-bit). Quick smoke shows numeric hallucination/scale errors in invoice examples. Anyone free to triage?
raj: Can you paste a repro?
maria: Example from smoke: 
```
User: 'Total payable: $9.50'
Model: 'Total: $950'
```
and 
```
User: 'Balance: 2,345.67 USD'
Model: 'Balance: 234567 USD'
```
sophia: Those look like token concatenation issues. Did the LoRA introduce new BPE merges or sentinel tokens?
drew: We ran the adapter conversion script last night. It has a merge step that can prefer incoming merges over base unless flagged.
raj: If the adapter's merges got applied to the tokenizer, sequences like ["2", ",", "345"] could become one token "2345" or "234567" depending on surrounding splits. That explains both examples.
sophia: I dumped tokenization for the second case: 
```
base_tokens: ["Balance", ":", " ", "2", ",", "345", ".", "67", " ", "USD"]
adapter_tokens: ["Balance", ":", " ", "234567", " ", "USD"]
```
maria: Great catch. Pipeline log shows merge_vocab step used default precedence (adapter first).
drew: Fix options: 1) remap adapter merges back to base during conversion 2) force adapter to reuse base tokenizer ids 3) add a targeted post-merge token normalization. Which do we want for a quick unblock?
raj: Easiest: redo conversion with --prefer-base-moves and re-quantize. Should be quick (~1.5-2h). Also add a smoketest for comma/decimal patterns so it doesn't regress.
sophia: I'll spin an evalpack run with tokenize_debug=true across 100 invoice-like prompts to quantify impact. ci-bot: job started - build/bermuda-lora/token-debug #8543.
ci-bot: build/bermuda-lora/token-debug #8543 queued
sophia: Results preliminary: 100 examples -> 19 token-merge anomalies, numeric-extract accuracy dropped 0.97 -> 0.79.
drew: OK that's a blocker. I'll open a small PR that flips the preference flag and adds a unit test for digit+comma patterns.
drew: PR: https://phabricator.redwood.ai/D12456 (patch + test + pipeline flag)
maria: Once PR lands, re-run quantize + quick evalpack. If numbers recover, we can promote to 10% canary.
raj: Canary plan: 12h, 10% traffic, monitor metric: invoice_amount_exact_match and token-level diffs; rollback if accuracy < 0.9 for >5m.
sophia: I'll add an alert and a Grafana panel for the metric.
ci-bot: build/bermuda-lora/token-debug #8543 finished (logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/8543)
maria: Thanks all. Tagging this thread for follow-ups.
